rows.en:
Yes, that's right.
Since you're here, let's take a break
and have some tea together.

Phew.
The tea you make really is delicious, Nanase.
Ahaha, thank you very much.

No, thank you. Thanks for the tea.
Let's do this again sometime.
(Drinking Nanase's tea really calms me down.)

(Think I'll stop by the art room again
and see how Nanase's doing~)

Oh, \p-san.
You came again.

Yeah. You're working on your assignment
again today too, right, Nanase?
(Nanase's tea really is calming, isn't it.)

(Research at the library, huh...
Looks like Nanase's gonna help me out,
so let's get it done fast.)
Nanase, thanks for helping out.

Oh, it's nothing. I don't have work today,
and besides, we're classmates, aren't we!
So what is it we're researching, anyway?
Right, right. Gary-sensei asked me to do it, and...
rows.notes: x2, player; trails into the explanation (next row '...So that's the deal').

rows.en: ...So that's the deal.

Wow~, that sounds like a lot of work.
Then let's split it up and knock it out!
Yeah, let's get started right away.
Oh, isn't this the material we need?
There, this is the last one!
Phew~ Looks like we somehow finished...
Yes, we finished surprisingly fast.
Yeah, maybe it's thanks to your help, Nanase?
Oh no, I didn't do anything...

Nah, I guess that's what working a part-time job
does for you. You were super efficient.
rows.notes: Male (sasuga fudan kara baito shite iru dake atte).

rows.en:
No, at work I've got Ranka-san there with me,
so it's really not worth that much praise...
No, you really saved me. Thanks.

Really, when you say it like that...
I-I'll be heading home now. Bye!

(I didn't think we'd finish this fast.
I owe Nanase one.)

(Research at the library, huh...
Looks like Nanase's gonna help me out,
so let's get it done fast~)
Nanase, thanks for helping me out.
Yeah, having you here is reassuring.
...So that's the deal.

Wow~, that sounds like a lot of work.
Then let's split it up and knock it out!
rows.notes: Female version (same text as c11576 bar a comma).

rows.en: Right, then let's get started right away.
Phew~ Looks like we managed to finish...
Yeah, it's all thanks to your help, Nanase.

No, no, I guess that's what working a part-time job
does for you. You were super efficient.
No, you really saved me. Thanks a lot.

(I didn't think we'd finish this fast.
I'll have to thank Nanase.)

(Research at the library again, huh...
But Nanase says she'll help me out.)
rows.notes: Male. The Japanese ends with a blank line (full-width space), dropped as in c11799.

rows.en:
Oh, Nanase.
Thanks for helping again today.

Don't mention it, we're classmates!
Come on, let's get started!

Phew, we somehow finished...
You saved me, Nanase.
Not at all. We both worked hard, huh.
Yeah, seriously, great work.
(She really saved me. That's Nanase for you.)

(Research at the library again...
But Nanase says she'll help me out.)
rows.notes: Female. Trailing blank line dropped as in c11799.

rows.en: Yeah, that's right.

Phew, we somehow finished...
You saved me, Nanase.
(She really saved me. That's Nanase for you.)

(I asked Nanase out to thank her for helping
me the other day, but...)

Oh, \p-kun.
Sorry to keep you waiting.

Nah, I just got here myself.
Well then, shall we go?

Okay, today's my thanks for your help the other day.
It's my treat, so order whatever you like.

Oh, okay, then I'll take you up on that...
Tea and cake, please.

Oh, that's all you want?
That's pretty ordinary...
Look, they've got a Galaxy Parfait and stuff, see?
rows.notes: Male. Galaxy Parfait: menu item, not in the glossary.

rows.en:
Um, I really like Nyan-Nyan's dim sum and stuff.
So plain tea and cake is actually rare for me.

Huh, is that so?
Then isn't working at Nyan-Nyan perfect for you?

Hmm..., I guess so.
But the trouble is, there's a lot of temptation.

It's true!
When you're a little hungry and your favorite food
is right there, it's a huge temptation!
I see. Even more so if it's sweets, I guess?

Yes... I have to watch it a bit more...
How should I put it... it's a little...
rows.notes: x2, Nanase; she hints at her weight without saying it (kept unsaid).

rows.en: Then couldn't you just work somewhere else?
No way!
Oh, I see...

Yes, because then I'd get fewer chances
to see Ranka-san...
I see. That's a tough problem indeed...

But Nyan-Nyan has Ranka-san, and the uniforms
are cute, so I just have to resist a little temptation!
I guess you're right.
More importantly...
Why do you always invite me?
(Hmm, why is that, I wonder...)
Well, not that I mind.
Oh, okay.

Oh, I know! If you'd like, come by the shop sometime.
Next time, I'll be the one thanking you!
Oh, no, today was my idea in the first place...
I'll treat you to Nyan-Nyan's best dim sum and tea.
Oh, that might be nice...

Then it's decided!
If you're coming, please let me know beforehand.

(She steamrolled me, but I'm kinda looking
forward to it.)

uncertain: c11622 (x2): Nanase's unfinished hint (worrying about her weight from snacking) kept unsaid.
missing_glossary: Galaxy Parfait (gyarakushii pafe), a menu item, c11616 (also c11645 in slice 159)
